112:             ProducerState::Producing(tail) => {

115:             ProducerState::Idle(tail) => {
116:                 self.tail == tail

120:             ConsumerState::Consuming(head) => {
121:                 self.head == head

123:             ConsumerState::Idle(head) => {

133:         // Note that self.head = self.tail means empty range
134:         0 <= i && i < self.len() && (
135:             if self.head <= self.tail {
136:                 self.head <= i && i < self.tail
137:             } else {
138:                 i >= self.head || i < self.tail
139:             }

148:         || self.consumer == ConsumerState::Consuming(i)

152:     // is correct. For each index, there are three possibilities:
153:     //
154:     //  1. No cell permission is stored
155:     //  2. Permission is stored; permission indicates a full cell
156:     //  3. Permission is stored; permission indicates an empty cell

159:     // producer/consumer/head/tail state.

161:     pub open spec fn valid_storage_at_idx(&self, i: nat) -> bool {
162:         if self.is_checked_out(i) {
163:             // No cell permission is stored
164:             !self.storage.dom().contains(i)

167:             self.storage.dom().contains(i)

172:             && if self.in_active_range(i) {

175:             } else {
176:                 // The cell is empty
177:                 self.storage.index(i).is_uninit()
178:             }
179:         }
180:     }

182:     #[invariant]
183:     pub fn valid_storage_all(&self) -> bool {

185:             self.valid_storage_at_idx(i)

263:             // In order to complete the produce step,
264:             // we have to be in ProducerState::Producing.

266:             let tail = pre.producer.get_Producing_0();

286:             // both the shared version and the producer's local copy.
287:             // Also, move back to the Idle state.
288:             update producer = ProducerState::Idle(next_tail);
289:             update tail = next_tail;
290: 
291:             // Check the permission back into the storage map.
292:             deposit storage += [tail => perm] by { assert(pre.valid_storage_at_idx(tail)); };
293:         }

298:         consume_start() {
299:             // In order to begin, we have to be in ConsumerState::Idle.
300:             require(pre.consumer.is_Idle());

302:             // We'll be comparing the consumer's _local_ copy of the head

304:             let head = pre.consumer.get_Idle_0();
305:             let tail = pre.tail;
306: 
307:             assert(0 <= head && head < pre.backing_cells.len());
308: 
309:             // We have to check that the buffer isn't empty to proceed.
310:             require(head != tail);
311: 
312:             // Update the consumer's local state to be in the `Consuming` state.
313:             update consumer = ConsumerState::Consuming(head);
314: 
315:             // Withdraw ("check out") the permission stored at index `tail`.
316: 
317:             birds_eye let perm = pre.storage.index(head);
318:             withdraw storage -= [head => perm] by {
319:                 assert(pre.valid_storage_at_idx(head));
320:             };

337:             assert(0 <= head && head < pre.backing_cells.len());
338:             let next_head = Self::inc_wrap(head, pre.backing_cells.len());
339: 
340:             update consumer = ConsumerState::Idle(next_head);
341:             update head = next_head;
342: 
343:             require(perm.id() == pre.backing_cells.index(head as int)
344:               && perm.is_uninit());
345:             deposit storage += [head => perm] by { assert(pre.valid_storage_at_idx(head)); };
346:         }
347:     }

443: pub fn new_queue<T>(len: usize) -> (pc: (Producer<T>, Consumer<T>))
444:     requires
445:         len > 0,
446:     ensures
447:         pc.0.wf(),
448:         pc.1.wf(),
449: {
450:     // Initialize the vector to store the cells
451:     let mut backing_cells_vec = Vec::<PCell<T>>::new();
452:     // Initialize map for the permissions to the cells
453:     // (keyed by the indices into the vector)
454:     let tracked mut perms = Map::<nat, cell::PointsTo<T>>::tracked_empty();
455:     while backing_cells_vec.len() < len
456:         invariant
457:             forall|j: nat|
458:                 #![trigger( perms.dom().contains(j) )]
459:                 #![trigger( backing_cells_vec@.index(j as int) )]
460:                 #![trigger( perms.index(j) )]
461:                 0 <= j && j < backing_cells_vec.len() as int ==> perms.dom().contains(j)
462:                     && backing_cells_vec@.index(j as int).id() == perms.index(j).id()
463:                     && perms.index(j).is_uninit(),
464:     {
465:         let ghost i = backing_cells_vec.len();
466:         let (cell, cell_perm) = PCell::empty();
467:         backing_cells_vec.push(cell);
468:         proof {
469:             perms.tracked_insert(i as nat, cell_perm.get());
470:         }
471:         assert(perms.dom().contains(i as nat));
472:         assert(backing_cells_vec@.index(i as int).id() == perms.index(i as nat).id());
473:         assert(perms.index(i as nat).is_uninit());
474:     }

477:     let ghost mut backing_cells_ids = Seq::<CellId>::new(
478:         backing_cells_vec@.len(),
479:         |i: int| backing_cells_vec@.index(i).id(),
480:     );

482:     let tracked (
483:         Tracked(instance),
484:         Tracked(head_token),
485:         Tracked(tail_token),
486:         Tracked(producer_token),
487:         Tracked(consumer_token),
488:     ) = FifoQueue::Instance::initialize(backing_cells_ids, perms, perms);
489:     // Initialize atomics
490:     let tracked_inst: Tracked<FifoQueue::Instance<T>> = Tracked(instance.clone());
491:     let head_atomic = AtomicU64::new(Ghost(tracked_inst), 0, Tracked(head_token));

513: impl<T> Producer<T> {
514:     fn enqueue(&mut self, t: T)
515:         requires
516:             old(self).wf(),
517:         ensures
518:             final(self).wf(),
519:     {
520:         // Loop: if the queue is full, then block until it is not.
521:         loop
522:             invariant
523:                 self.wf(),
524:         {
525:             let queue = &*self.queue;
526:             let len = queue.buffer.len();
527:             assert(0 <= self.tail && self.tail < len);
528:             // Calculate the index of the slot right after `tail`, wrapping around
529:             // if necessary. If the enqueue is successful, then we will be updating
530:             // the `tail` to this value.
531:             let next_tail = if self.tail + 1 == len {
532:                 0
533:             } else {
534:                 self.tail + 1
535:             };
536:             let tracked cell_perm: Option<cell::PointsTo<T>>;
537:             // Get the current `head` value from the shared atomic.
538:             let head =
539:                 atomic_with_ghost!(&queue.head => load();
540:                 returning head;
541:                 ghost head_token => {
542:                     // If `head != next_tail`, then we proceed with the operation.
543:                     // We check here, ghostily, in the `open_atomic_invariant` block if that's the case.
544:                     // If so, we proceed with the `produce_start` transition
545:                     // and obtain the cell permission.
546:                     cell_perm = if head != next_tail as u64 {
547:                         let tracked cp = queue.instance.borrow().produce_start(&head_token, self.producer.borrow_mut());
548:                         Option::Some(cp)
549:                     } else {
550:                         Option::None
551:                     };
552:                 }
553:             );
554:             // Here's where we "actually" do the `head != next_tail` check:
555:             if head != next_tail as u64 {
556:                 // Unwrap the cell_perm from the option.
557:                 let tracked mut cell_perm = match cell_perm {
558:                     Option::Some(cp) => cp,
559:                     Option::None => {
560:                         assert(false);
561:                         proof_from_false()
562:                     },
563:                 };
564:                 // Write the element t into the buffer, updating the cell
565:                 // from uninitialized to initialized (to the value t).
566:                 queue.buffer[self.tail].put(Tracked(&mut cell_perm), t);
567:                 // Store the updated tail to the shared `tail` atomic,
568:                 // while performing the `produce_end` transition.
569:                 atomic_with_ghost!(&queue.tail => store(next_tail as u64); ghost tail_token => {
570:                     queue.instance.borrow().produce_end(cell_perm,
571:                         cell_perm, &mut tail_token, self.producer.borrow_mut());
572:                 });
573:                 self.tail = next_tail;
574:                 return ;
575:             }
576:         }
577:     }
578: }
